en: A sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small European village nestled in a hilly countryside landscape. There are several detached houses with steep roofs and a prominent building in the foreground bearing the sign 'Restaurant & Café Toscana.' The upper left corner features printed text reading 'Bad Elster. Ortsteil Kessel.' The area is surrounded by fields, trees, and forested hills.
